card.name: Infusion and injection rate numbers
card.fires_on: The space or digit just before a number giving how fast or how long to give an injection or infusion, after phrases like "not to exceed", "rate of", or "approximately".

modes.label: Space before rate number
modes.description: The blank token right after a rate or duration phrase, just before the number.
modes.example: administered via slow (approximately<< >>2 minutes) subcutaneous injection

modes.label: Digit inside rate number
modes.description: A digit within a rate figure such as mg per minute.
modes.example: give at the rate of approximately 1<<0>>0 mg (2 mL) per minute
